description: Reusable self-authored question templates for AWS Certification Coach generation.

prompt_variants: A team is reviewing an AWS design and needs a solution that can {purpose}. Which AWS service or feature should they choose?
During exam preparation, explain which AWS service or feature is best suited to {purpose}.
An AWS workload must {purpose}. Identify the most appropriate service or feature and explain why.
Which AWS capability best meets a requirement to {purpose}? Explain the selection.
templates.question_pattern: Explain which AWS service or feature should be used to {purpose}.

selection_rule.instruction: Choose the single best AWS service or feature.

distractor_recipes.description: Use a plausible but incorrect service or feature from the service scenario.
Use a service or feature from a different AWS problem domain.
Use an option that misses an important scenario constraint or operational requirement.

service_scenarios.purpose: grant temporary credentials to trusted AWS resources without storing long-term access keys
track cost or usage thresholds and send alerts for actual or forecasted spending
improve high availability and fault tolerance during an Availability Zone impairment
preserve, retrieve, and restore previous versions of objects after overwrite or delete events
automatically transition or expire objects based on age and access patterns
transition old S3 objects to lower-cost storage classes and expire them after a retention period without changing bucket access permissions
provide synchronous standby replication and automatic failover for relational databases
scale read-heavy database workloads by serving read traffic from replicated database instances
provide a fully managed NoSQL key-value and document database with low-latency access
replicate tables across Regions for low-latency multi-Region access and resilience
run event-driven code without managing servers and scale per request
adjust EC2 capacity automatically based on demand and health checks
horizontally scale an EC2 application by adding and replacing instances automatically instead of manually moving to a larger instance type
distractors: manual vertical scaling to a larger instance type

service_scenarios.purpose: distribute traffic across healthy targets to improve availability and scalability
cache and deliver content from edge locations to reduce latency for users
provide scalable DNS routing and health-check-based routing for applications
act as stateful virtual firewalls controlling inbound and outbound traffic for resources
provide stateless subnet-level traffic filtering with explicit inbound and outbound rules
record AWS API activity for auditing, governance, and operational troubleshooting
collect metrics, logs, alarms, and dashboards for monitoring AWS resources
track resource configuration history and evaluate compliance against rules
create and manage encryption keys used to protect data in AWS services
store, retrieve, and rotate application secrets such as database credentials
decouple application components with a managed message queue
fan out messages to multiple subscribers using a managed pub/sub service
publish the same event to multiple independent subscribers without requiring each subscriber to poll a shared work queue
buffer units of work so competing worker processes can poll, process, and delete messages at their own pace
route events from AWS services and applications to targets using event buses and rules
orchestrate multi-step workflows and coordinate distributed application components
create, publish, secure, monitor, and throttle APIs for backend services
provide shared elastic file storage that can be mounted by multiple compute resources
create point-in-time backups of block storage volumes for recovery or copying
store rarely accessed archival data at lower cost with retrieval-time tradeoffs
run analytical queries against a managed petabyte-scale data warehouse
perform serverless data integration, cataloging, and ETL jobs
query data in Amazon S3 using SQL without managing servers
ingest and process real-time streaming data at scale
centrally manage multiple AWS accounts and apply service control policies
set maximum available permissions across accounts in an AWS Organization
provide recommendations for cost optimization, security, fault tolerance, performance, and service limits
review workloads against AWS best practices and identify improvement opportunities
centralize and automate backup policies across supported AWS services
add user sign-up, sign-in, and identity management to applications
protect web applications from common web exploits using rules

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A Lambda function processes messages from an SQS queue. A few messages repeatedly fail and delay later processing. Which configuration should the developer use to isolate failed messages while allowing successful messages to continue?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Configure the Lambda event source mapping with an SQS dead-letter queue so failed messages can be isolated after retries.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A team exposes a Lambda-backed REST API and must run custom token validation before requests reach the backend function. Which API Gateway feature should the developer configure?
developer_question_scenarios.correct_option: Use an API Gateway Lambda authorizer.
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Use an API Gateway Lambda authorizer to run custom authorization logic before invoking the backend Lambda integration.
distractors: Create an AWS WAF rate-based rule only.
Store the token in AWS Secrets Manager.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: Two application instances may try to create the same DynamoDB item at the same time. Which DynamoDB write approach should the developer use to prevent replacing an existing item?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Use a DynamoDB conditional write with a condition expression such as attribute_not_exists to avoid overwriting an existing item.
distractors: Run a table scan before each write.
Replicate the table with global tables.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A development team wants its release pipeline to compile code and run unit tests automatically before deployment. Which AWS service should be added as the build action?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Add AWS CodeBuild as a CodePipeline build stage to compile the application and run tests automatically.
distractors: Run commands manually on an EC2 instance.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A serverless application has intermittent latency across several downstream calls. Which AWS service should the developer use to trace each request through the distributed workflow?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Use AWS X-Ray distributed tracing and service maps to follow requests and identify latency across downstream calls.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A Lambda function needs different non-secret configuration values in development and production. Which Lambda feature should the developer use to pass those values at runtime?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Use Lambda environment variables to provide non-secret function configuration values that can differ by deployment environment.
distractors: Store the values in CloudWatch Logs.
Create an IAM role for each value.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A developer must keep application database passwords out of code and periodically replace them without a manual handoff. Which AWS service should manage this credential lifecycle?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Use AWS Secrets Manager to store database credentials and configure scheduled rotation for the secret.
distractors: Store the password in a Lambda environment variable.
Place the value in a CloudFormation output.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: An SQS consumer sometimes needs several minutes to finish processing a message. Which queue setting should the developer adjust so another worker does not immediately receive the same message?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Adjust the SQS visibility timeout so a message remains hidden from other consumers while the current worker processes it.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: An application must run code whenever items in a DynamoDB table are inserted, updated, or deleted. Which event-driven pattern should the developer configure?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Enable DynamoDB Streams and configure a Lambda event source mapping so item changes invoke the function.
distractors: Schedule a table scan from EventBridge.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A public API must protect its backend from sudden request spikes by limiting client request rates. Which API Gateway feature should the developer configure?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Configure API Gateway throttling with rate and burst limits to protect backend integrations from request spikes.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A deployment workflow uses a managed build project that must run the same install, build, and test commands every time. Where should the developer define those command phases?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Define the install, build, and test command phases in an AWS CodeBuild buildspec file for the managed build project.
distractors: Define the phases in a CodeDeploy AppSpec file.
Put commands in an IAM policy.
Create an API Gateway stage variable.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A serverless maintenance task needs to invoke a Lambda function every hour. Which AWS service feature should the developer configure?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Create an EventBridge scheduled rule with the Lambda function as the target for recurring serverless execution.
distractors: Configure an SQS dead-letter queue only.
Run the function from a local cron job.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A production Lambda function can overwhelm a downstream database during traffic spikes, but the team also wants guaranteed capacity for that function. Which Lambda setting should the developer configure?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Configure Lambda reserved concurrency to reserve capacity for the function and cap its concurrent executions to protect downstream systems.
distractors: Add an API Gateway usage plan only.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: An asynchronously invoked Lambda function must send successful results to one target and failed invocation records to another target for follow-up processing. Which feature should the developer use?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Configure Lambda destinations for asynchronous invocations so success and failure records are routed to the appropriate targets.
distractors: Create a CloudWatch metric alarm only.
Return a custom HTTP response from the function.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A REST API release should expose a new deployment to 10 percent of callers while most clients continue using the current API stage. Which API Gateway deployment feature fits this rollout?
developer_question_scenarios.correct_option: Use an API Gateway canary release.
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Use an API Gateway canary release on the stage to send a configured percentage of traffic to the new deployment.
distractors: Create a CloudWatch Logs metric filter only.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A partner-facing API needs different request quotas for each client application, and callers will include API keys. Which API Gateway configuration should the developer create?
developer_question_scenarios.correct_option: Create an API Gateway usage plan with API keys.
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Create an API Gateway usage plan, associate API keys with it, and configure quota and throttling limits for those clients.
distractors: Configure an S3 bucket policy only.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A session table in DynamoDB stores an expiration time for each item and should remove old sessions without a scheduled cleanup job. Which feature should the developer enable?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Enable DynamoDB TTL on the expiration timestamp attribute so DynamoDB automatically deletes expired table items.
distractors: Run a full table scan from EventBridge.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: An order workflow must update an inventory item and create an order item in DynamoDB, and either both writes must succeed or neither should be saved. Which DynamoDB API pattern should the developer use?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Use DynamoDB transactions with TransactWriteItems to perform atomic all-or-nothing updates across the required items.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A DynamoDB table is keyed by customer ID, but the application now needs fast lookups by order status without scanning every item. What should the developer add to support this access pattern?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Add a DynamoDB secondary index with the alternate partition key so the application can use efficient Query operations and avoid table scans.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A payment workflow uses SQS and must preserve message order for each account while reducing duplicate processing attempts. Which queue type and message metadata should the developer use?
developer_question_scenarios.correct_option: Use an SQS FIFO queue with message group and deduplication IDs.
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Use an SQS FIFO queue with message group IDs for ordering and deduplication IDs to reduce duplicate processing within the deduplication interval.
distractors: Use a standard SQS queue with no grouping.
Configure an SNS fanout topic only.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: An SNS topic publishes all order events, but each subscribed queue should receive only messages for selected order types based on attributes. Which SNS feature should the developer configure?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Configure SNS subscription filter policies that match message attributes so each subscriber receives only the relevant fanout messages.
distractors: Use an SQS delay queue only.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A web application must let an authenticated user download one private S3 object for a limited time without changing the bucket to public access. What should the developer generate?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Generate an S3 presigned URL with an expiration to provide temporary access to the private object without making the bucket public.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A client application uploads multi-gigabyte files to S3 over an unreliable network and needs to retry only the failed pieces instead of restarting the whole upload. Which S3 upload method should it use?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Use S3 multipart upload to split a large object into parts, upload them independently, and retry failed parts without restarting the full upload.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: An application needs to encrypt large payloads locally while using AWS KMS to protect the key material. Which encryption pattern should the developer implement?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Use KMS envelope encryption: generate a data key, encrypt the data locally, and store the encrypted data key protected by a customer managed key.
distractors: Store plaintext keys in Lambda environment variables.
Use an API Gateway Lambda authorizer.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: Several Lambda functions need to read shared non-rotating configuration values organized by application and environment path. Which AWS service should the developer use?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to keep hierarchical application configuration parameters and retrieve them at runtime.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A mobile application needs managed sign-up, sign-in, password recovery, and tokens for its end users. Which Cognito feature should the developer configure?
developer_question_scenarios.correct_option: Configure an Amazon Cognito user pool.
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Configure an Amazon Cognito user pool to provide managed user registration, authentication, password recovery, and token issuance.
distractors: Create an IAM group for the users.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A team releases a new Lambda version and wants 10 percent of alias traffic to move first, with automatic rollback if CloudWatch alarms fire. Which deployment service should the developer use?
developer_question_scenarios.correct_option: Use CodeDeploy for Lambda traffic shifting.
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Use AWS CodeDeploy for a Lambda deployment that shifts alias traffic gradually and rolls back when configured alarms are triggered.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A CodeBuild project runs unit tests and the team wants test case results visible in CodeBuild instead of only raw log output. What should the developer configure?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Configure a CodeBuild report group and buildspec report file paths so CodeBuild collects and displays structured unit test results.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A Lambda application writes JSON logs to CloudWatch Logs, and a developer needs to search recent log groups for common error codes and counts. Which CloudWatch capability should be used?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Use CloudWatch Logs Insights to run queries against selected log groups and analyze error patterns in application logs.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A developer instruments an application with X-Ray and needs to filter traces by tenant ID in the X-Ray console. Which kind of trace data should the code add?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Add X-Ray annotations to segments because annotations are indexed metadata that can be used in trace filter expressions.
distractors: Create an API Gateway usage plan.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: Several services publish domain events, and the platform team wants rules to route matching custom events to different Lambda targets without direct service-to-service calls. Which EventBridge resource should be used?
developer_question_scenarios.correct_option: Use a custom EventBridge event bus with rules.
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Use a custom EventBridge event bus and rules to receive custom application events, match event patterns, and route them to targets.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A Step Functions workflow calls several Lambda tasks and should retry transient errors, then move to a compensating path when retries are exhausted. What should the developer define in the state machine?
developer_question_scenarios.correct_option: Define Step Functions Retry and Catch handlers.
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Define Retry and Catch handlers in the Step Functions state machine to retry transient errors and transition to fallback states when failures persist.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: Multiple Lambda functions use the same internal utility library, and the team wants to manage that library separately from each function package. Which Lambda feature should the developer use?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Use a Lambda layer to package shared libraries separately and attach the layer to each function that needs those dependencies.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: A CI pipeline pushes application container images to Amazon ECR, and security wants vulnerability findings before promotion to production. Which ECR capability should be enabled?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: Enable Amazon ECR image scanning on the repository so container images are scanned for known vulnerabilities before deployment.
distractors: Configure an API Gateway Lambda authorizer.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: Review the IAM policy for the Lambda execution role. What is the access-control issue, and what change best matches least privilege?
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: The policy allows s3:GetObject on every resource with Resource "*". For least privilege, scope the permission to the required object ARN pattern, such as arn:aws:s3:::example-bucket/reports/*.
distractors: Add s3:PutObject to the same policy statement.
Replace the execution role with an IAM user access key.
Move the bucket name into a Lambda environment variable.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: Review the Lambda handler. What security problem should the developer fix before deployment, and what AWS service is the best fit?
developer_question_scenarios.correct_option: Store the credential in AWS Secrets Manager and retrieve it at runtime.
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: The password is hard-coded in the Lambda deployment package. Store the credential in AWS Secrets Manager, grant the execution role permission to read it, and retrieve it at runtime instead of shipping the secret in code.
distractors: Keep the password in the source file and encrypt the zip file manually.
Put the password in CloudWatch Logs for auditability.
Use provisioned concurrency to protect the password.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: Review the SDK helper. Why can this function miss objects, and what SDK pattern should the developer use?
developer_question_scenarios.correct_option: Use an S3 ListObjectsV2 paginator and iterate through every page.
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: The code calls list_objects_v2 once, so it can return only the first page when the bucket has more results. Use the SDK paginator for ListObjectsV2 and iterate over each page before collecting keys.
distractors: Store static access keys in the source file.
Disable S3 versioning on the bucket.
Increase Lambda memory to force more results into one response.

developer_question_scenarios.generated_question: Review the SAM template. The function deploys but receives AccessDenied when it calls GetItem. What is missing from the template?
developer_question_scenarios.correct_option: Add a least-privilege DynamoDB read policy for the Sessions table to the function.
developer_question_scenarios.reference_answer: The template passes the table name but does not grant the Lambda execution role permission to read the table. Add a least-privilege SAM policy, such as DynamoDBReadPolicy scoped to SessionsTable, or an equivalent IAM policy on the function role.
distractors: Output the table name as plaintext to fix AccessDenied.
Change the Lambda runtime to Node.js.
Add a CloudWatch dashboard for the table.
